title: Joe Kohlmann, Stillwater City Administrator
script:
This is the New Saint Croix Union. Wednesday's account is Joe Kohlmann, City Administrator of Stillwater.

The city's Administration page lists Joe Kohlmann as City Administrator. The staff directory lists the same office as City Administrator and Treasurer. The city's departments page says Administration is responsible for overall city operation, carrying out the policies and actions of the City Council. It says the City Administrator also acts as the City Treasurer.

The Administration page does not say how Kohlmann came to the office.

Stillwater's mayor and council page describes a mayor-council form of government. The council is the governing body of the city. It is composed of a mayor elected at large and four council members elected by wards. The council acts as the legislative body. It may enact ordinances. It makes and is responsible for all policy decisions.

The mayor listed on that page is Ted Kozlowski. The term printed there expires January 3, 2027. The four council members printed there are Ryan Collins of Ward 1, term listed through January 3, 2027; Lindsay Belland of Ward 2, term listed through January 2, 2029; Larry Odebrecht of Ward 3, term listed through January 2, 2029; and Michael Polehna of Ward 4, term listed through January 3, 2027.

The Administration page says the Administration Department helps the City Administrator manage the functions of all other city departments and oversees the implementation and links them to the City Council's policies and decisions.

In addition to coordinating council activities, Administration is also responsible for Human Resources, Intergovernmental Relations, and the duties of the City Clerk's Office.

The page lists what the department does. It prepares agendas and provides support information for twenty-four regular meetings and about eight special meetings each year. It facilitates the activities of the city's management team to carry out council directives. It oversees public service delivery by all city departments. It prepares the annual city budget for council consideration. It coordinates personnel services for Stillwater's regular city employees. It publishes and distributes the city newsletter and manages the city website. It administers licenses and permits. It provides city records retention. It administers local and state elections. It represents city positions with federal, state, county, and other city governments, and with agencies such as the Minnesota Department of Transportation and Washington County. It coordinates the activities of the City Attorney's office.

The Administration page lists the office staff with Kohlmann. Elizabeth Bechel is Administrative Services Director. Beth Wolf is City Clerk. Jenna Schmid is Deputy City Clerk. Asha Altermatt and Sofia Prado are administrative assistants.

The city's data-practices page names Joseph Kohlmann, City Administrator, as the authority for government data the city holds. The office is at City Hall, 216 Fourth Street North. Hours printed there are eight in the morning to four-thirty in the afternoon, weekdays.

The office's own page is in the show notes.
